skill.name: wiki-page-writer
skill.description: Creates evidence-based technical wiki pages with VitePress frontmatter, Mermaid diagrams, and source citations.
skill.summary: Writes structured technical wiki pages with diagrams and source-backed explanations.

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code formatting, Mermaid syntax, and documentation validation wording. I found no evidence of executable shell commands, network access, prompt injection, or malicious intent in SKILL.md. The skill asks agents to read repository files for documentation, so users should scope it to code they may summarize.

content.value_statement: Technical docs often drift from implementation details. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to write cited wiki pages with diagrams.
actual_capabilities: Creates Markdown wiki pages with VitePress frontmatter.
Adds Mermaid diagram requirements for architecture and data flow sections.
Requires source citations with file paths and line numbers.
Structures pages into overview, architecture, components, data flow, implementation, and references.
Guides validation of paths, class names, and Mermaid compatibility.
limitations: It does not execute diagram rendering or documentation publishing by itself.
It depends on the agent reading the target repository accurately.
It may cite Unknown when evidence is missing.
It is tailored to technical documentation, not general marketing copy.

use_cases.title: Document a component
use_cases.description: Create a wiki page that explains a component, its purpose, and its implementation with source citations.

use_cases.title: Map system architecture
use_cases.description: Produce architecture notes with Mermaid diagrams, component summaries, data flow details, and references.

use_cases.title: Prepare onboarding docs
use_cases.description: Turn existing code into structured documentation that helps new contributors understand important paths and decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Document one component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a focused page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a wiki page for [component]. Read the relevant files, cite evidence, and include Mermaid diagrams.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a feature flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a VitePress wiki page for [feature]. Cover purpose, architecture, components, data flow, implementation details, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Map a subsystem
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for cross-file architecture notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [subsystem]. Trace the real code paths, cite at least five source files, and show the main interactions with diagrams.

prompt_templates.title: Create an evidence review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for source-backed technical depth.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a deep technical wiki page for [system]. Separate facts from inference, explain design reasons, and flag missing evidence.

output: A Markdown wiki page with VitePress frontmatter.
Sections for overview, architecture, components, data flow, implementation, and references.
At least two Mermaid diagrams and file-line citations.

output_examples.output: A structured page that explains the authentication flow, important classes, configuration tables, and cited implementation details.
A technical deep dive with diagrams, component summaries, data movement notes, and references to relevant source files.

best_practices: Provide the repository area and audience before asking for a page.
Ask the agent to verify citations against actual file paths.
Review generated diagrams before publishing docs.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad repository documentation without a scope.
Do not publish pages with Unknown citations left unresolved.
Do not use it for legal, policy, or marketing content without review.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is Markdown guidance and does not include executable scripts.

faq.question: What output format does it target?
faq.answer: It targets Markdown pages that work well in VitePress.

faq.question: Does it require source code access?
faq.answer: Yes. It needs relevant source files to produce accurate citations.

faq.question: Can it create Mermaid diagrams?
faq.answer: It instructs the agent to include at least two Mermaid diagrams per page.

faq.question: Is it suitable for private repositories?
faq.answer: Use it only in environments where reading and summarizing code is allowed.

faq.question: Can it publish the wiki page?
faq.answer: No. It writes page content but does not publish it.
